meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: Claude 会通过 CDP 协议控制你已装的 Chrome，复用现有登录态：打开网址、等待加载、执行 JavaScript、取页面快照、提取 auth token。注意首次启动会关掉你正在用的 Chrome，需先经你同意。
howto.when: 当你提到「浏览器操作」「CDP」「复用登录态」等关键词，或需要控制浏览器抓取 token 时触发。

say.text: 用 CDP 打开 https://www.qidian.com 并等它加载完
say.note: 会打开页面并等待加载

say.text: 把当前页面正文的前 8000 字文本取出来
say.note: 在页面上执行 eval 返回文本

say.text: 从浏览器里取出 localStorage 的 token

howto.what_en: Claude drives your installed Chrome over CDP and reuses existing login sessions: opening URLs, waiting for load, running JavaScript, taking snapshots, extracting auth tokens. Its first launch kills your normal Chrome, so it asks for your consent first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "browser automation", "CDP", "reuse login session" and similar keywords, or ask to control the browser to extract a token.

say_en.text: Use CDP to open https://www.qidian.com and wait for it to load
say_en.note: Opens the page and waits for load

say_en.text: Get the first 8000 characters of the page body text
say_en.note: Runs eval on the page and returns text

say_en.text: Pull the token from localStorage in the browser
